rules.threshold: every size on the declared type scale; neighbours ≥ 1.15×; ≤ 8 sizes
one role, one size on a page and across a template's pages
one h1 per page; no level skipped; size never grows with the level
section title ÷ body ≥ 1.5
font-weight ≤ 600
capitals only at ≤ 12px with tracking ≥ 0.06em
45 ≤ characters per line ≤ 90 (45 for prose only)
the longest text (> 200 chars) sits in a column ≥ 480px
padding, margin and gap on 4·8·12·16·24·32·48·64·96·128
≤ 2 distinct gaps between bands
every content container on one left edge
12 ≤ text elements above the fold ≤ 32
every picture in a hard box; one ratio per role, on a page and across pages; nothing drawn 0×0
card pictures on one surface, with one fit
a product card has a background, a border or a rounded picture
one main frame; thumbnail ratio = frame ratio (±0.01); product page ≤ 6000px at 1280
product pictures carry a real alt; no image lacks the attribute; no «Product image 1»
the no-photo placeholder sits in the frame's own ratio box; an empty block draws nothing
card roles in canon order; the same product has one card signature on every page
tabular-nums; no «,00»; no-break space before ₽; card price differs from the title in weight or size
radii only 6 · --radius · 12 · pill; one radius per component role across pages
≤ 1 shadow recipe
≤ 4 icon-only controls in one header row
the footer's surface differs from the page
titles, prices and buttons are on top at their own point
0 page errors
0 axe color-contrast violations (AA)
0px horizontal overflow
every target ≥ 44px high; icon-only ≥ 44px wide; inline links exempt
a visible focus ring, distinct from rest, on every target
durations ≤ 240ms; under prefers-reduced-motion ≤ 10ms

notPorted.why: checks the text of the lab's own template files; on the storefront the long text is the shop's catalogue, not the template
a source check of literal values in block CSS; `pnpm lint:blocks` does it on src/modules/blocks
scale tokens a lab template overrode; a manifest here names closed layers only, held by validateTemplate()
